Name: Warlord's Challenging Modded Bundles
Author: alittlewarlord1
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3]I was inspired to make this bundle mod after playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6361]Challenging Community Center Bundles[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36858]Vegas' Mega Modded Bundles[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41164]glymr's Bigger Better Bundles (SVE)[/url] - all of which I highly recommend you try out! However, I noticed that many of my favorite mods often weren't included in other bundle mods like them, and while glymr's is definitely more of a challenge than the vanilla Community Center, I tend to enjoy something closer to what CCCB offers difficulty-wise. So I decided to fill the niche myself! Hopefully someone else out there will enjoy it, too.[/size]

[size=3]While some of the machines required to create items for the Bulletin Board are locked behind Special Orders, [b]they are also provided as rewards for completing other bundles[/b], so you won't just be relying on luck to get what you need! Theoretically, if you plan well, befriend the right people, and know your way around the mods I've included, you can complete the Community Center in year 1, whether you're playing Remixed or not. [/size]

[size=3]Also, while most of the rooms have a few sets of bundles that will always be present when selecting Remixed Bundles at the start of the save, they also all have [i]many [/i]more possible variations than Vanilla; for example, the Bulletin Board has a) no default bundles, b) eight bundles to complete, and c) [b]30 possible bundles to choose from. [/b]It's entirely possible that you'll never run into some of them even after multiple runs![/size]

You can view a spreadsheet documenting all bundles and rewards [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1fTnWNS1xnPIAuM1hJhfVmucXbUP4__1zlYUNnYXn-yY]here[/url], if you want to be able to plan ahead.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- Download and install SMAPI. Make sure you're playing on Stardew Valley 1.6 or above.[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- Download and extract [b]ALL MODS[/b] listed in the Requirements section, either at the top of the mod page or further down in the description, as well as [b]all of their dependencies[/b], into your Stardew Valley/mods folder[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]- Download and extract this mod's .zip into your mods folder[/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]IMPORTANT: [/b]Like any other bundle mod, this one only works on [b][u]new saves, with SVE's bundles disabled in the SVE config.[/u] [/b]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to do that easily before world creation, if you haven't already. Also ensure that you have all bonus content enabled in the Cornucopia mod configs, including World Traveler - Extended in the Cooking Recipes mod.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Incompatibilities:[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This mod DOES NOT WORK with other mods that edit the Community Center and/or Abandoned Joja Mart bundles, nor does it work with mods that alter the Prize Machine prizes. This includes Completionist's Complete Community Center; I can't offer compatibility with CCCC, as there are simply too many bundles to account for. If anyone knows how to make a patch for it, though, be my guest, and I'll link it here in the future![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Required Mods:[/b][/size]
[size=3]Cornucopia Suite ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Flowers[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Artisan Machines[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39057]Cooking Recipes[/url]) Note: Make sure you have all of the extended features enabled for each mod in their respective configs.[/size]
[size=3]Mizu's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25028]Quail[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25071]Turkey[/url][/size], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45161]Peafowl[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45763]Reindeer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46295]Phoenix[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45939]Deer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46466?tab=description]Yak[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46469]Bison[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45160]Goose[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45533]Dodo[/url], as well as their Animal Husbandry addons (note that in the requirements tab, the duplicate of Mizu's Yak is meant to point to the AHM addon)
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist[/url] addon[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34843]Camelus[/url] addon, as well as Camelus's Animal Husbandry addon[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url] + [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883]Eli and Dylan[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword and Sorcery[/url] addons[/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]Machine Progression System[/url] [/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3578]More New Fish[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22591]Adventurer's Guild Expanded for 1.6[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39216]Cloths and Colors[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21038]Rocks and Relics[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24982]Custom Prize Machine Prizes[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33744]More Abandoned Joja Mart Bundles[/url][/size]

[b][size=4]Recommended But Not Required:[/size][/b]
[size=3](Note: I will not be linking to all of these, but they are all hosted here on Nexus.)[/size]
[spoiler][size=3][b]Functional/Quality of Life:[/b]
GMCM, Lookup Anything, NPC Map Locations, and UI Info Suite 2 Alternative to reduce time spent clicking between a wiki window and the game.
Help Wanted and Better Special Orders to improve the quest systems and make it easier to get the Artisan Machines that are locked behind SOs.
Walk of Life, Aquarism, Springmyst, and Wildcat to add skill prestige, improve fish ponds and combat, and flesh out the skill side of the game a bit more. WoL works by default with LoC and CaC, as well as other SpaceCore skill mods.
Forager's Nooks and Crannies to have a few more places to find the Rose and the Alchemist/Sunberry forage out and about.

[b]Added Challenge:[/b]
Fresh Farm Produce to add a monthly competition based on what you sell and how quickly you sell it after it's grown/produced.
Tool Upgrade Bundles to make tools cost more than some money and metal.
Broken Farmhouse to make the acquisition of house upgrades more difficult (keep in mind that it doesn't work with custom farm house maps).
Stardew Valle Balance Overhaul Continued (DISCONTINUED) (yes i know it says discontinued but i like this one the best) to change up some pretty fundamental ways the Valley's economy works, and a whole lot more. 
Serfdom to make yourself pay income and property taxes.

[b]Story/NPCs:[/b]
Lurking in the Dark, Cottagecore Goes Metalcore, and Nora the Herpetologist to fill out East Scarp a bit more. If you want to use Lavril, I believe you also have to download the compatibility patch in East Scarp's additional files.
All Sunberry Village addons (Ripley, Wren, Always Raining in the Valley, Jonghyuk and Spanner, Dao) for an even more fleshed out village and story.
Tilly the Tea-Loving Librarian, because she's awesome.[/size][/spoiler]
